THREE SEPARATE PIPELINES. Summary of what is OPEN vs CLOSED as of 24 Sep 2026.

=== A) NOMURA GLOBAL CAMPUS BOARD (Oleeo, nomuracampus.tal.net) — 44 live 2027 programmes, ZERO IN INDIA ===
I broke through the Cloudflare/Altcha gate and read the full board. Region breakdown: EMEA 22, AEJ (Asia ex-Japan) 13, Americas 9. AEJ = Hong Kong and Singapore ONLY. India/Mumbai/Powai appears NOWHERE on this board. Nomura India campus hiring is NOT run through this portal.

The AEJ ones he is actually eligible for (HK/SG based, not Mumbai — but these are the only Nomura graduate programmes on earth he can apply to right now):

1. "2027 Global Markets Graduate Internship Program - Hong Kong" (opp 1488) and "- Singapore" (opp 1487).
   DEADLINE: "Please apply before 11:55pm, Wednesday 30 September 2026 (HKT)" — SIX DAYS AWAY. STATUS: OPEN.
   Verbatim eligibility: "We welcome diversity in our teams and would encourage students from all background and disciplines who are in your final year of study to apply. Candidates applying for this program must be available to commit for the entire duration of the Graduate Internship (February to April 2027) and commence for Graduate Analyst Program by July 2027. Fluency in written and spoken English is required, while additional Asian language skills will be a value-add."
   Verbatim programme text: "The Graduate Internship will start around February 2027 and run for nine weeks in our Hong Kong office... This program is a key pipeline for our Graduate Analyst Program in Asia." Teams: Sales, Structuring, Trading, Research.
   Verbatim "About You": "While no specific advanced degree or path of study is required, we look for team players who are curious with strong quantitative skills and a keen interest in business and finance."
   >>> THIS IS THE SINGLE BEST-FITTING THING NOMURA HAS FOR HIM. Feb-April 2027 maps exactly onto his Jan-May 2027 final semester, it explicitly requires final-year students, no specific degree, and it converts to a July 2027 full-time start — which matches his May 2027 graduation. Downside: Hong Kong / Singapore, so it needs a visa and relocation.
   URL: https://nomuracampus.tal.net/vx/lang-en-GB/mobile-0/appcentre-1/brand-4/xf-433b6a7a9219/candidate/so/pm/1/pl/1/opp/1488-2027-Global-Markets-Graduate-Internship-Program-Hong-Kong/en-GB

2. "2027 Risk Management Graduate Program – Hong Kong" (opp 1483) and "– Singapore" (opp 1482). Full time, Level: Analyst, 2-year programme, 3 rotations across Market Risk / Credit Risk / Operational Risk.
   DEADLINE: "Please apply before 11:55pm, Wednesday 30 September 2026 (HKT)". STATUS: OPEN.
   Verbatim eligibility: "We welcome diversity in our teams and would encourage students from all background and disciplines who are in your final year of study (and be available to commence in July 2027) to apply. Fluency in written and spoken English is required."
   Verbatim "About You": "We are looking for graduates with: Genuine interest in risk management and financial markets / Strong academic achievement / Naturally inquisitive with an analytical mindset to understand risk and financial data / Strong organizational skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment / Excellent written and verbal communication skills"
   >>> No finance degree demanded, no years demanded, explicitly final-year + July 2027 start. Excellent fit for his analytics profile.

3. "2027 Finance Graduate Program – Hong Kong" (opp 1526) and "– Singapore" (opp 1527). Full time, Level: Analyst, 2 years.
   DEADLINE: "Please apply before 11:55pm, Saturday 31 October 2026 (HKT)". STATUS: OPEN.
   Same verbatim eligibility line as #2 (final year of study, commence July 2027).
   Verbatim: "Students from all advanced degree or path of study are welcome." and "Learn how to use the key digital tools (Power BI, Alteryx & Python) and AI tools in your daily work" — i.e. they will TEACH him Alteryx/Power BI, he does not need it going in.

4. Other AEJ, less relevant: "2027 International Wealth Management Summer Internship Program – Hong Kong / – Singapore" (30 Sept 2026), "2027 Investment Banking Summer Internship Program - Hong Kong / - Singapore" (30 Sept 2026), "2027 Investment Banking Graduate Program, Singapore" (31 Oct 2026), "2027 Global Markets Summer Internship Program - Hong Kong / - Singapore" (30 Sept 2026 — these are for PENULTIMATE-year students, so NOT him).

*** CRITICAL RULE, VERBATIM, ON EVERY ONE OF THESE PAGES: "Please note that you can only apply to one opportunity globally per academic year. We review applications on a rolling basis and interviews can be arranged prior to the application deadline. We encourage you to apply as soon as you are ready."
He gets exactly ONE shot across the entire Nomura campus system this year. He must pick one — my read is the Global Markets Graduate Internship (HK or SG), because it is the only one whose Feb-Apr 2027 window fits his final semester AND rolls into a July 2027 full-time offer. If he will not relocate, he should pick the Risk Management Graduate Program instead (also July 2027 start).
Enquiries: earlycareersaej@nomura.com

=== B) NOMURA SERVICES POWAI INTERNSHIP PROGRAM (INDIA ONLY) — EXISTS, BUT NOT PUBLICLY APPLYABLE ===
Verbatim from https://www.nomura.com/careers/early-careers/internship-programs/ :
"Nomura Services-Powai Internship Program (India only) — Internship opportunities are open for 6 and 2 month durations. The internship program includes roles in Global Markets, Investment Banking, Technology & Corporate Functions."
STATUS: no public application link anywhere. It is not on the Oleeo campus board and not on careers.nomura.com. The India careers page says verbatim: "Interested Applicants may reach out to the College Placement Committee."
>>> The 6-month Powai internship is exactly the Jan-to-June final-semester slot. It is routed ENTIRELY through college placement cells. ACTION: DJSCE's TPO is the only door. A referral into Nomura Powai HR (indiarecruitment-in@nomura.com) is the second door.

=== C) INDIA CAMPUS CONTESTS (the real PPI/PPO pipeline for Powai) — CURRENTLY CLOSED ===
1. "Global Markets Quant Challenge" (4th edition), Powai Quants team. Verbatim eligibility: "Graduating Batch of 2027 (B. Tech and Dual Degree) / Streams: All branches". Verbatim key dates: "Registration Closes – May 19, 2025, 11:59 PM IST / Challenge Begins – May 23, 2025, 06:00 PM IST / Challenge Ends – May 25, 2025, 06:00 PM IST". Verbatim: "This challenge also presents an opportunity for a PPI (pre-placement interview) or a PPO (pre-placement offer)." Contact: gmquantchallenge@nomura.com
   STATUS: CLOSED (that edition ran May 2025). The registration buttons on the live page are HTML-commented out. BUT note it was explicitly aimed at the Batch of 2027 = HIS batch. A 5th edition, if it runs, would be his last chance and would land around April-May of a cycle. He should email gmquantchallenge@nomura.com now to ask to be notified / whether a 2026-27 edition is running.
2. "KakushIN" (9th edition) coding contest, Nomura Services India. Verbatim: "KakushIN provides a great platform to pit yourself against the brightest minds from selected top technology colleges..." and "An opportunity to get a PPI (pre-placement interview) or a PPO (pre-placement offer)". Verbatim 2024 outcomes: "499 team registrations / 94 teams short listed for executive summary presentations / 20 teams hosted for the grand finale / 8 full time offers, 4 full time offers + Internship offers and 20 Internship offers extended". Teams of 2. Contact: kakushin@nomura.com
   STATUS: registration form present but the "Register for KakushIN now" control is HTML-commented out; page footer still reads "Copyright © 2025" — i.e. the page has not been refreshed for the 2026-27 cycle. Treat as CLOSED / between editions. Mumbai colleges do participate (SPIT Mumbai alumni testimonials are on the page). ACTION: email kakushin@nomura.com asking when the 10th edition opens and whether DJSCE is on the invited-college list — and get DJSCE's TPO to request inclusion.
3. "Global Markets Women's Mentorship Program" — women only, and eligibility is "graduating in or before 2026". NOT applicable.
4. "RE-IGNITE 6.0 - Transforming Careers for Women" (job id 1007622700, live on careers.nomura.com) — women returners with a 2+ year career break and 5+ years experience. NOT applicable.

=== D) EVERGREEN BACK DOOR (open right now, Mumbai) ===
"Nomura Talent Community", Mumbai, job id 1308384900, posted 27 Aug 2026. Verbatim: "By joining our talent community, you are not applying to a specific role but expressing interest in being considered for future roles that align with your background and goals." Also "Opportunity in Non Technology", Mumbai, job id 1146136400, posted 6 Sep 2026 — description body is literally the single word "TBD", i.e. an evergreen CV-collector req for non-tech Powai roles. Both are zero-cost applications that put his CV in the Powai ATS. Low yield alone; high yield if paired with a referral.

=== REFERRAL LEVERAGE (high) ===
careers.nomura.com is SuccessFactors RMK with no publicly posted referral code, and 291 Mumbai reqs nearly all demand 1+ years. A cold application from a 2027 graduand will be auto-filtered on the Experience field. The leverage points are, in order: (1) DJSCE TPO -> Nomura Powai campus team for the 6-month Powai internship; (2) an employee referral submitted internally against a specific requisition number (several reqs carry one — e.g. 13616, 13845, 11008, 12401, 12908, 13290, 14744 — quoting the requisition number in a referral is what gets a CV past the years-of-experience screen); (3) indiarecruitment-in@nomura.com, the India recruitment mailbox published on nomura.com/india/careers.
limitations:
WHAT I GOT
- Full, reliable access to Nomura's experienced-hire feed. careers.nomura.com is SAP SuccessFactors RMK (server-rendered HTML, no JSON API). I paginated the India set (startrow 0/100/200) and pulled 292 India rows, then fetched and parsed 181 individual job-detail pages after excluding pure software-engineering, infrastructure, QA, infosec, legal, audit and real-estate reqs. Every India req carries a machine-readable "Position Specifications" table (Corporate Title / Functional Title / Experience / Qualification / Requisition No.), so the years-of-experience figures and qualification lines above are verbatim from the live pages, not inferred.
- Full access to the campus/early-careers board. This initially failed: nomuracampus.tal.net (Oleeo) sits behind Cloudflare plus an Altcha "Quick Check Needed" CAPTCHA, and both plain curl and WebFetch got the CAPTCHA shell. I got through by using a complete browser header set (modern Chrome UA, Accept, Accept-Language, Sec-Fetch-*, Upgrade-Insecure-Requests) with a cookie jar and a nomura.com Referer. That returned all 44 live programmes with titles, locations and deadlines, and the individual /opp/ detail pages with verbatim eligibility text.

WHAT I COULD NOT GET, AND WHY
1. Posting CLOSE dates for the 292 Mumbai experienced-hire reqs. SuccessFactors RMK exposes datePosted in a meta tag (I captured it for all 181 detail pages I fetched) but publishes no application deadline or "apply by" field at all. So for every Mumbai role above I can tell you when it was posted but NOT when it closes. Several were posted the same week, including one posted today (e-Client Services, 24 Sep 2026).
2. Number of openings per requisition. Only one req (GM-Strucng, 1432861500) printed "No. of Position: 1". The rest do not disclose headcount, so I cannot tell you whether the three identical eFI Strategy reqs are three seats or three postings of one search.
3. Job titles as displayed in the search list are internal role-family codes (e.g. "RSK-Model Validation Group", "OPS-PM / CBIT-Metrics", "FIN_Grp Fin Cntrl_AN"), not marketing titles. There is no cleaner public title; the <h1> on the detail page repeats the same code. I have kept the codes and added a plain-English descriptor, clearly separated. I have not invented any title.
4. I did not fetch detail pages for the ~110 India reqs I excluded by title filter (Software Engineer, Principal/Lead/Sr Software Engineer, Quality Engineer, Infrastructure & Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Operations & Services, Information Security, Support Analyst, Legal/Paralegal, Auditor, Corporate Real Estate, CTO, Head of Legal, Trader, RE-IGNITE). It is possible one of those hides an analytics-flavoured role, but their titles are unambiguous. One detail fetch also failed on a network timeout — job id 1391323500, "OPS-PM / CBIT-Metrics", Mumbai — so that one req's qualification text is unverified. I have NOT listed it as a role.
5. Four India reqs have an empty or placeholder description body and therefore no qualifications at all. Verbatim body text: "Opportunity in Non Technology" (1146136400) = "TBD"; "Mgr - Data Governance" (1429959800) = "TBD\nTBD"; "WSO-Strategy" (1412741000) = "TBD"; "GM-GM Origination Analyst" (1423854000) = "LPI - to be on hold". That last one appears to be an on-hold req. I have not fabricated requirements for any of these; I listed only the Talent Community / Non-Technology pair, flagged for what they are.
6. The India careers programmes page (nomura.com/india/careers) is stale — its footer reads "Copyright © 2025" and the "Register Now" / "Register for KakushIN now" buttons are HTML-commented out. So I can report the last published edition's dates and eligibility verbatim, but I CANNOT confirm whether a 2026-27 edition of KakushIN or the Global Markets Quant Challenge is being planned, or when it would open. That has to be settled by emailing kakushin@nomura.com / gmquantchallenge@nomura.com or via the DJSCE placement cell. I have not guessed at dates.
7. The Nomura Services-Powai Internship Program (India only, 6 and 2 month durations) is described on nomura.com but has NO public application route anywhere — not on careers.nomura.com, not on the Oleeo campus board. I could not find an apply link because there does not appear to be one; the India careers page says applicants should go via the College Placement Committee. I cannot tell you whether it is open right now.
8. Salary, shift and visa details are not published on any of these pages, with two exceptions I captured verbatim: RSK-Risk Methodology 1431797900 states "Working Shift: EMEA", and OPS-GMO/Loans 1430936500 states "we have openings for AEJ, EMEA and US shifts".
9. Applying via the Oleeo campus board requires account registration; I did not create an account, so I could not see any India-only vacancies that might be gated behind login. Based on the public facet counts (EMEA 22 / AEJ 13 / Americas 9 = 44, all accounted for by Hong Kong, Singapore, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, London, Paris, Frankfurt, Milan, Madrid, Zurich) there are no hidden India rows in that list.

ONE HARD CONSTRAINT WORTH REPEATING
Every Nomura campus programme page states verbatim: "Please note that you can only apply to one opportunity globally per academic year." He gets exactly one application across the entire Nomura early-careers system this year, and the nearest deadline is 30 September 2026 — six days from today.
